decisions.authority: Owner-approved CODEX TASK 1 binding execution contract; supersedes stale handoff routing for this bounded assignment.
decisions.decision: Keep generator-selected lib/authz policies and CRM tenant-scoped behavior; enforce mandatory non-CRM customer boundaries outside the replaceable policy module. Use transaction-held locks and the insert-only audit ledger for one-time live initial-owner allocation; seed fixtures do not allocate.
follow_up: Protected CRM/public preservation is static-review only, pending owner QA.

Upstream ABAC policies.abac.ts.tpl accepts clientVisible without a customer relationship. It cannot be changed in this task. Sensitive consumers enforce mandatory boundaries independently; upstream direct helper parity remains unresolved.
PortalDocument and Invoice need an authenticated customer-recipient relationship before VIEWER access may be enabled.
Owner allocation durability relies on the existing insert-only audit ledger. Destructive tenant deletion/restoration must preserve the allocation history.
